purpose: Record the NFRDI-FPHRDD/FishCoRe value-chain study as a promising request route for current Cordillera fishery data, without turning commodity and managed-stock labels into species-by-waterbody occurrences.

study.leadInstitution: National Fisheries Research and Development Institute — Fisheries Postharvest Research and Development Division
study.program: Philippine Fisheries and Coastal Resiliency (FishCoRe), Fisheries Management Areas 6 and 9
study.statusAsReportedAtPublication: Study implementation and validation activities were underway; the notice says further field data collection was still to follow.
methodsAsReported: Focus group discussions with local government units, provincial fisheries staff, and tilapia/goby producers
Key informant interviews to validate priority municipal areas and fishery commodities

retrieval.searchLimit: A small search of official FishCoRe and NFRDI-indexed pages for the study title and named taxa did not surface a final report or dataset; this is not proof that no output exists.

evidenceLimits: The official notice is a project update, not the VCA report or a biological survey.
Province-level commodity/managed-stock labels do not show a fish's wild occurrence, exact waterbody, or aquaculture-versus-capture source.
The notice does not identify validated municipalities, fish survey methods, stations, vouchers, taxon-by-site records, raw tables, coordinate precision, or a public data license.
The stated ten-year production/traceability data may include fishery-chain or aquaculture records and must not be treated as wild population/abundance without a subsector crosswalk.
nextAction: Use the unsent request draft to ask NFRDI-FPHRDD/FishCoRe for the final VCA report and any shareable aggregated data; request methods, exact province/municipality and waterbody crosswalk, wild-capture versus aquaculture separation, time period, data dictionary, accepted taxon names, spatial uncertainty, confidentiality limits, and reuse/attribution terms. Verify the official recipient channel before sending; no inquiry has been sent.

sources.supports: BFAR FishCoRe reports an NFRDI-FPHRDD value-chain study in FMA 6/9, names commodity/managed-stock labels for Cordillera provinces, reports FGD/KII validation, and describes ten-year production/traceability and spatial-distribution work.
